sentences.section: (lead)
sentences.text: Dervish Hima (1872–1928), born Ibrahim Mehmet Naxhi, was a 19th-century Albanian politician and one of the delegates who participated at the Albanian Declaration of Independence.

sentences.section: Early life
sentences.text: Dervish Hima was born in Struga to an Albanian landowning family, which spoke the Albanian language in the Tosk dialect.

sentences.section: Early life
sentences.text: In August 1908 Hima left his studies unfinished and devoted himself to the Albanian national movement.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Hima also gave speeches to enthusiastic audiences against pan-Islamic influences coming from the Young Turks and called for Albanian national unity, which resulted in an attempted assassination in Korçë by the Ottoman government.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: During June 1900 an Albanian newspaper was published in Turkish and Romanian at Bucharest with no connections to any Albanian societies.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: At the time Hima and Jashar Erebara, both students from Istanbul University were its editors and the paper advocated for an independent Albania ruled by a foreign prince and protected by the Great Powers.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: The newspaper later ceased publication due to a lack of money and complaints from the Ottoman embassy in Romania.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Hima writing in the fortnightly called for the unification of the Albanian vilayets and autonomy for Albania within the Ottoman Empire.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: The Italians shut down his journal Albania-Arnavudluk which promoted Albanian nationalism and Hima planned to restart publishing activities at Geneva.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: For Ottoman authorities Hima's journal was seen as being only a revolutionary appeal.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: In Paris, Hima was a delegate at the Congress of Ottoman Opposition (1902) organised by Prince Sabahaddin.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: A committee was founded in Paris by Hima and Dimitri Papazoglou, an Aromanian captain that sought to make Albert Ghica the prince of Albania.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Hima's committee was active in Romania and symbolised a Romanian-Albanian rapprochement while the group held anti-Slav and anti-Greek positions.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: The Ottoman authorities viewed Hima as a pawn of Damad Mahmud Pasha and Ismail Qemali.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Hima and Jashar Erebara, another delegate of the 1902 Congress both published a Turkish-Albanian journal for Shpresa, an Albanian nationalist society.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: In Geneva the remaining members of the old CUP organisation faced a diplomatic assault by Ottoman authorities.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: In a final act CUP members of Albanian descent Hima, Ahmed Rifat and Halil Muvaffak founded a bilingual journal İttihad-ı-Osmanî-La Federation Ottomane.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: To give the appearance that the periodical was established by Ottoman citizens of other ethnicities, an editorial board was created composed of figureheads selected from expatriates of various Ottoman ethnic communities.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Information was gathered on the periodical by the Swiss political police.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Under the editorship of Hima, the inaugural issue of İttihad appeared on 23 February 1903 with the first article recommending an Ottoman federal system of government with stress placed on Albania as being most suitable for that type of administration.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Additional articles discussed reforms of the state, linguistic self determination within the empire and Ottoman unity.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: The periodical was initiated as a Young Turk publication and in short time became an organ of the Albanian national movement and was written in prose style to attract Albanians.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: İttihad was unable to last as Swiss authorities of the time undertook strict measures against Albanian opponents of the Ottoman sultan.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Hima was a follower of Ibrahim Temo and was instructed by him to write in Young Turk journals with the aim of achieving reconciliation between the Young Turks and Albanian opponents of the sultan.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: The restoration in 1908 of the Ottoman constitution allowed for political exiles like Hima to return home.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: In his newspaper Hima stressed the importance of Albanian identity and language by viewing them as being two sides of the same coin.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: He outlined that the publication was aimed at enlightening Albanians, raising their levels of intellect and culture along with encouraging cooperation and an understanding of Ottomanism, the Ottoman system, empire and its peoples in relation to them toward improving their situation.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Arnavud was used by Hima to address the Ottoman government and keep Albanian issues within the public sphere while his newspaper printed petitions and letters by Albanians and Albanian deputies of the Ottoman parliament on matters such as the Albanian alphabet question.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Hima also highlighted Albanian sacrifices and contributions to the empire, claimed that Albania was "the cradle of freedom" and defended use of the tribal law of Dukagjin among Albanian highlanders.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: He advocated for a unitary province of Albania, Albanian-Turkish language schools, and locals undertaking military service within five provinces in the Ottoman Balkans.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: On 13 December 1910 Hima raised concerns in Arnavud about Ottoman "militarization" of placing army officers into civil administration positions in Albania instead of qualified bureaucrats and protesting the use of force to resolve local problems.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: The newspaper was shut down at the end of 1910, part of the wider campaign by the Ottoman government against the Albanian Latin character alphabet and schools.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Hima stated at the time that he received assistance for his publishing activities from Albanians within the empire.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: In 1911 he published a book Musaver Arnavud (The Illustrated Albanian) in Ottoman Turkish and it was an edited work containing chapters by Hima and other Albanians on history and other topics like the geopolitical situation of Albanians.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Hima's book highlighted the narrative of Albanian loyalty and sacrifice to the empire and he stressed the development of an "Albanian national literature" as important for Albanians.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: During the Albanian revolt of 1912, the vali of Yanina, Mehmed Ali singled him out as being a bad influence on people in the region and Hima wired the Porte with complaints about the behavior of the governor.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: In the late Ottoman period, Hima supported Austro-Hungarian assistance toward Albanian geopolitical interests in the Balkans.

sentences.section: Late Ottoman period and Albanian independence
sentences.text: Hima was one of the signatories of the Albanian Declaration of Independence.

sentences.section: Later life
sentences.text: Hima died in 1928.

caveats.text: The sanctions list for this topic area (Eastern Europe) has only 24 hand-checked entries, against about a hundred for the Arab–Israeli conflict. This figure is likely an undercount, and comparing it with better-covered areas would overstate the difference.
Treat this as a minimum. The hand-checked list starts in 2023, so topic bans from earlier years are not counted. Long-established articles are affected most.
